note: Difficulty levels against the ghost of history (v3, sim-endgame). Chosen at New Game: sim.new_game({"difficulty": id}). ghost_strength multiplies the ghost's track values (population by its square root); start_gold is added to the 1948 treasury; inflation_drift scales how fast the player's fiscal record moves inflation off history's path; ai_pressure adds to the strength of hostile formations; programme_cost scales national programme costs; ending_margin raises the ending thresholds (ratios against history) by that share; hints=false hides Recommended badges and history's choice until after the pick (Historian). Gameplay balance constants, not historical claims.

levels.name: Easy
levels.desc: History is a softer benchmark (its record counts 6% lower), a larger 1948 treasury, inflation that answers slowly to deficits, weaker enemy formations and cheaper national programmes. For learning the systems.

levels.name: Normal
levels.desc: History's record as it was. The intended game.

levels.name: Hard
levels.desc: History's record counts 6% higher, the 1948 treasury is thinner, deficits feed inflation a third faster, enemy formations are stronger and national programmes cost more.

levels.name: Historian
levels.desc: Hard's benchmark and pressures (history counts 10% higher), with no Recommended badges and history's own choice hidden until after you decide: you weigh every option on its sources alone.
